rows.grounds: demonstrative pronoun referring to the previously mentioned reality
absolutive expressing prior action leading to the result
compound describing the concealed essential nature
abstract noun denoting the state of omniscience
verb indicating the emergence of omniscience as a result

items.question: What attainment follows from knowing the hidden true nature?
premises: A hidden true nature exists as an object of knowledge.
Knowing that hidden true nature is possible.
Omniscience arises as a consequence of that knowledge.
items.inference: Knowing the hidden true nature results in the arising of omniscience.
uncertainties: The exact referent of taṃ depends on the preceding context.
items.plain_english: Having known that hidden true nature, omniscience arises.
